title: How Amit Shah Planned The Opposition’s DOWFALL | India’s Modern Chanakya
description:
In this video, we discuss how after the 2024 elections, when BJP failed to cross the “400 paar” mark, many leftists and opposition leaders started saying that BJP’s dominance was over. At the same time, opposition parties also came together under the INDIA alliance to challenge BJP. But instead of panicking, Amit Shah treated it like a challenge. He reportedly created separate strategies for every major state and focused on strong booth-level planning and organization. Slowly, BJP started winning key states like Haryana, Delhi, West Bengal, Maharashtra, Assam, and Uttar Pradesh. Even in states where there was no strong BJP wave before elections, results still came in BJP’s favor. The video explores how BJP’s planning helped weaken many regional parties.
